description: Insult, tease, or otherwise antagonise another Sim — whichever mean-family entry the target's pie menu currently offers. Prerequisite: target is within pie-menu range and exposes a mean-family entry; note the target can refuse the interaction via an incoming accept/reject dialog (respond-interaction). Effect: queues the resolved interaction; on completion the target's relationship to you drops on the friendship axis and their mood may deteriorate (TTAB-driven). Cost: in-sim minutes; queue slot; social consequences are durable — this is not a throwaway op.

args.name: target_sim_id
args.description: Persist ID of the target Sim.

args.name: target_object_id
args.description: Local ObjectID of the target Sim.

args.name: queue_mode
args.description: How this social interaction lands on your action queue. 'queue' (default) cancels engine autopilot (Mode.Idle entries from spawn-objects and BHAVs) before enqueueing. 'preempt' cancels everything currently in your queue and runs this immediately.

call_signatures: cf $CF be-mean --target_object_id <object_id>                                       # alternate; must resolve to a VMAvatar
common_mistakes: Directed socials (be-friendly/flirt/tell-joke/be-mean/give-gift) resolve target pie-menu by ALIAS substring; if the target's pie menu has no matching entry the handler returns ok=false with the list of available names — read the error to pick a different verb.
Passing --target_object_id for a non-avatar object silently fails these socials (they require VMAvatar target).
Speak rejects leading '/' — that prefix is reserved for admin chat commands; use admin-chat-command instead.
perception_hints: Target's current action (to judge if they're busy): perception.nearby_sims[].current_action
Your social motive (why this matters): perception.motives.social.value

Each queue entry's .mode tells you what's there: 'normal' = deliberate (yours or another Sim's social), 'idle' = engine autopilot. queue_mode='queue' clears 'idle' entries; queue_mode='preempt' clears all.
refuse_conditions: no matching pie-menu entry → ok:false with available-names list
